compatibility: New AI-owned derived view. Existing canonical-event-v1/three-source-1/ai-shadow-1 and frozen bundles unchanged.
identity_rules: event_key identifies one producer observation; request identity identifies one physical request in deployment/capture/key-domain scope
NGINX-generated request ID accepted only with attested overwrite/trusted-proxy chain; valid syntax alone is not proof
Sensor transaction uses sensor_instance+boot_scope+flow_id+tx_id; flow_id alone is never a request key
Join two sources only through trusted edge identity or response-ID-to-sensor-transaction proof; HTTP field consistency validates a join, never creates it
Do not require N present for SA: verified edge-response mapping may be retained while N log is missing; if proof absent keep separate records
SOURCE_EVENT is allowed for single-source evidence with physical_request_verified=false; no invented receipt
Multiple audit events for one request are legitimate distinct event types, not automatically ambiguity; conflicting authoritative values are ambiguous
Different HMAC domains cannot be compared without an authorized mapping; never regenerate keys or infer equality from time/IP
No forced equivalence of byte lengths, normalized paths or app/wire statuses across observation points; protocol profile defines comparability
time_rules: received_at is collector receipt time; available_at=max(receipt, parse/projection completion); event_time may be unknown/coarse; all stored wall times UTC
decision cutoff and watermark explicit; usable source means VALID non-context request event available_at<=cutoff; late evidence may be retained but cannot affect that revision
Feature available_at>=every contributor available_at and <=cutoff; post-response values require POST_RESPONSE scope; no future or same-request completed-flow leakage
Legacy available_at is NOT renamed received_at: dataset.py replaces fused timestamp with max(matches) without recomputing availability; migration needs original provenance
Unknown receipt/clock provenance prevents decision-time certification; content-only auxiliary task may remain useful without timestamps
Late data creates revision preserving canonical_sample_key and lineage; previous record hash required; revision is not a new training example
Context request counts deduplicate identities across sources; source dropout recomputes all dependent aggregates; history reset/embargo boundaries defined before fit

CURRENT_REQUEST versus PRIOR_CONTEXT is explicit. Window aggregates reference a versioned history manifest; all included events available by cutoff and completed strictly before cutoff. Watermark <= cutoff is a completeness boundary, not permission to use future events.
missingness_rules: presence, parse status, arrival status and field state are orthogonal; source silence does not prove healthy or benign
source mask excludes late/invalid/context-only events; observation map preserves their existence
EMPTY requires explicit observation of empty value/body; MISSING/PARSE_ERROR/TRUNCATED/UNSUPPORTED/REDACTED have null model values
CONTENT_VIEW has NONE source mask and no native events; publisher or DSL content is not relabeled NGINX
NONE on REQUEST_VIEW is an abstention/health case, not an eighth supported scoring mode
Tensor zero fill is allowed only behind explicit field/group masks after T05; output bias cannot fabricate an observed modality
Mixed valid/error or on-time/late observations use MIXED; per-event states remain authoritative. At least one valid current-request event on time is required for each usable source.
Ambiguous/unverified multi-source records are quarantine evidence only: mask NONE, no model features, no eligibility. Emit independently keyed single-source views when correlation cannot be proved.
Clock uncertainty unknown prevents certified request scoring: preserve evidence with NONE and no observed features.

labels.principle: Evidence basis and declared task are authoritative; tier is a legacy annotation, never a calibrated probability.

mapping.A_or_GOLD_or_B: Map to ATTACK_INTENT only after bound semantic Oracle or independent-review evidence; human review may remain PENDING for internal research
mapping.C_or_SILVER: PUBLISHER_ANOMALY; intent remains unknown unless separately evidenced
mapping.D_or_BRONZE: HEURISTIC_PROXY or UNLABELED; scenario/rule/teacher alone cannot supervise trusted intent

labels.independence: Oracle/reviewer/model/rule origins tracked; detector output cannot validate itself; exploit outcome is separate from intent and HTTP status
labels.family: Unknown family is null with masked loss, not benign and not a made-up seven-family classification
labels.weighting: No numeric confidence weights fixed in T02. Any later weights selected on TRAIN/DEV protocol, never TEST.

admission_and_splits: Four accounting units: raw observation, verified physical request, normalized representation, canonical versioned sample; presentations/aliases/revisions/dropout do not increase capacity
Original CAL/DEV/TEST/SEALED protection inherited by every derivative, dropout mask and revision; no role reassignment to TRAIN
Exact/label conflict and known lineage closure precede split; near similarity is a review relation with index recall/saturation tracked, not physical-identity proof
Canonicalization groups equivalent views only under the same feature contract, task and compatible labels; retain aliases and avoid excess gradient weight
ELIGIBLE_FOR_DECLARED_TASK means internal research eligibility, never formal production readiness; current T02 admits zero new records
Keep content-only weak-label reuse separate from native7mask training capacity; require both labels and native multi-source coverage for final detector claims

runtime_profiles.LOCAL_DEMO: Original-URI in-memory selected-header telemetry + passive namespace EVE + Student audit; gateway source attribution limits remain
runtime_profiles.LOCAL_HOST_VM: Installed telemetry suppresses query/body; preserve narrower feature profile rather than pretend parity
runtime_profiles.AWS: Same normalized contract; capture after TLS termination at declared observation point, trusted edge/IP chain and clock/receive metadata required; no AWS capture or verification exists in T02

roadmap_adjustments: Replace fixed634+32+24+16 budgeting with evidence-backed semantic feature families; choose tensor layout in T05 and width after pilot
Start with shared compact masked-input MLP; compare separate gated branches only if heterogeneous missingness warrants added complexity
Do not mandate an auxiliary publisher head or distillation: compare supervised-only versus weak-label pretraining/auxiliary loss using fixed protocol
Separate native masks from dropout-derived masks and unknown legacy coverage; never claim all7 masks from a full-source dataset alone
Do not read mixed TRAIN/test Parquet payloads to recover legacy207; dedicated train derivative exists
Non-empty SQLite WAL makes immutable main-file snapshots incomplete; T02 uses recorded manifest for postponed10M instead of checkpointing/copying source
next_task: T03: isolate and verify <=8CPU/16GiB total resource profile against existing uncommitted changes, without starting applications/training.

hashing_and_evidence.identity: HMAC-SHA256 over UTF-8 compact JSON array of strings [identity-profile-version, deployment, capture, producer/boot scope when needed, trusted request ID OR sensor instance/flow_id/tx_id]. Key domain identifies the secret/config version; no secret persisted. Event key uses producer namespace plus native event ID or immutable file coordinate+payload digest. Missing unique coordinates prevents dedup certification.
hashing_and_evidence.digests: sha256 is lowercase hex over exact asset bytes. representation/view keys use a pinned canonicalization profile including privacy projection, encoder/version, task and compatible-label group; do not conflate hashes from different profiles.
hashing_and_evidence.evidence_resolution: Hashes are references, not proofs by themselves. Later admission must resolve each identity/label/projection/history proof against the pinned ledger and verify scope/trust. T02 reference validation never grants production admission.
hashing_and_evidence.canonical_sample: Stable request lineage key or content-equivalence cluster under a declared task/feature contract. Revisions and dropout share it; conflicting labels quarantine a cluster. Cross-row lineage closure and protected-role dominance are mandatory before fit.
hashing_and_evidence.retry: Same event key+payload hash is idempotent; same event key+different payload hash is a conflict. New UUID event IDs are not automatically new requests.
